provenance.task: PAIR RECOVERY: hide the correspondence, score against the (patient, z_index) label
provenance.why_different_from_phase2: the true partner is IN the pool; Phase 2 excluded it deliberately
provenance.scoring: patient_hit (same patient) and exact_hit (same slice); chance = 1/n
provenance.learned_cost: inverse-OT diagonal theta fitted on TRAINING patients' true pairs, box+simplex
provenance.features: frozen DINOv2 pool4 -> label-free PCA -> G2/G3, one shared encoder for both modalities
